WITH f AS (
 SELECT row_number() OVER(ORDER BY p.proname COLLATE "C",pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) COLLATE "C",p.oid) ordinal,
 p.oid,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) args,p.prokind,l.lanname lang,p.prosrc,
 p.prosecdef,p.proleakproof,p.provolatile,p.proparallel,p.proisstrict,coalesce(p.proacl::text,'') acl,p.proowner
 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
 JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE n.nspname='pg_catalog'
), defs AS (
 SELECT ordinal,oid,proname,args,prokind,lang,prosecdef,proleakproof,provolatile,proparallel,proisstrict,acl,
 pg_get_userbyid(proowner) owner,
 CASE WHEN prokind='a' THEN 'AGGREGATE intrinsic '||prosrc ELSE pg_get_functiondef(oid) END declaration,
 CASE WHEN prokind='a' THEN (
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('transfn',a.aggtransfn::regprocedure::text,
 'finalfn',CASE WHEN a.aggfinalfn=0 THEN null ELSE a.aggfinalfn::regprocedure::text END,
 'combinefn',CASE WHEN a.aggcombinefn=0 THEN null ELSE a.aggcombinefn::regprocedure::text END,
 'serialfn',CASE WHEN a.aggserialfn=0 THEN null ELSE a.aggserialfn::regprocedure::text END,
 'deserialfn',CASE WHEN a.aggdeserialfn=0 THEN null ELSE a.aggdeserialfn::regprocedure::text END,
 'mfinalfn',CASE WHEN a.aggmfinalfn=0 THEN null ELSE a.aggmfinalfn::regprocedure::text END,
 'trans_type',a.aggtranstype::regtype::text,'init',a.agginitval,'kind',a.aggkind,'parallel',proparallel) FROM pg_aggregate a WHERE a.aggfnoid=oid)
 ELSE null END aggregate_configuration,
 has_function_privilege('anon',oid,'EXECUTE') anon_execute_catalog,
 has_function_privilege('authenticated',oid,'EXECUTE') authenticated_execute_catalog
 FROM f WHERE ordinal<=300
) SELECT ordinal,oid,proname,args,prokind,lang,prosecdef,proleakproof,provolatile,proparallel,proisstrict,acl,owner,
 declaration,md5(declaration) declaration_md5,aggregate_configuration,
 anon_execute_catalog,authenticated_execute_catalog FROM defs ORDER BY ordinal
order: proname COLLATE C, pg_get_function_identity_arguments COLLATE C, oid
